result.content:
Everything verified. Summary of the completed work:

## Fault
`packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts`, `DefaultResourceLoader.reload()`:

```ts
preTrustExtensions = await this.loadProjectTrustExtensions();
const projectTrusted = false;          // ← blanket refusal, resolver never called
this.settingsManager.setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted);
```

The injected `options.resolveProjectTrust` callback was dead code, so project resources could never load after a `true` decision and the resolver never observed the untrusted bootstrap pass.

## Repair (one line)
```ts
const projectTrusted = await options.resolveProjectTrust({ extensionsResult: preTrustExtensions });
```
The resolver is now called exactly once, after the untrusted bootstrap set is loaded, and its result is awaited before `setProjectTrusted(...)` — matching the existing pattern in `package-manager-cli.ts` (`bootstrap untrusted → resolve → setProjectTrusted`).

## Regression (`.prale-eval/regression.mjs`)
Loads the real production module via `createGraph` with hand-written boundary fakes (`SettingsManager` with async `reload`, `DefaultPackageManager` that only exposes the project extension when the settings manager is trusted, `loadExtensionsCached`, `loadSkills`, `loadPromptTemplates`, path/text/timing helpers) and drives `reload()` twice:

- **resolver → true**: asserts exactly one resolver call, `trusted=false` at call time, bootstrap set = user extension only, final set = `[project, user]`, settings trusted, decision applied strictly after `resolver:end`.
- **resolver → false**: asserts project extension stays unloaded, settings untrusted, decision applied after the awaited resolver settled.

## Validation
- `node --experimental-vm-modules .prale-eval/regression.mjs` → exit 0, "all assertions passed".
- With the faulty line temporarily restored, the same script exited 1 on `0 !== 1` ("reload() must consult the trust resolver exactly once"), then the fix was restored (verified by `git diff`).
- Limitation recorded in `validation.notes`: no `node_modules`, so the repo's vitest suites could not be run.

`.prale-eval/result.json` re-opened and confirmed: `task_id` `extension-trust/correction`, `repository` `earendil-works/pi`, `mode` `repair`, exact validation command, `status` `passed`, substantive notes. Only `resource-loader.ts` changed; `TASK.md`, `subject.mjs`, and locks are untouched.
